methods.label: Evaluate the sums and use a common denominator
methods.explanation:
First evaluate the sums in the numerators and denominators: \(2+4+6=12\) and \(1+3+5=9\). The expression becomes
\[
\frac{12}{9}-\frac{9}{12}
=\frac43-\frac34
=\frac{16}{12}-\frac9{12}
=\boxed{\frac7{12}}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
